description: A walk records, for each entry, its size and its owner beside its mode and modification time: what Atoll's own view presents of a folder, a symlink or an ignored file, without waking its disk. A folder's size is what its filesystem gives, a symlink's the length of its target, an ignored file's its length. A later walk records them again: a file that grew is its new size.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[rule]]
label = "partial"
filename = "*.part"
action = "ignore"

steps.query: SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), kind, CASE kind WHEN 'dir' THEN size > 0 ELSE size END, uid = (SELECT uid FROM copies) AND gid = (SELECT gid FROM copies) FROM entries ORDER BY lpath
SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), size FROM entries WHERE kind = 'ignored'
